section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single validation study (referred to as 'the present study') of the Persian adaptation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) conducted in Tehran, Iran. The sample comprised 568 men and 525 women drawn from seven universities (total N = 1093); the BAS-2 showed a one-factor solution and satisfactory psychometric properties.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire provided abstract; key sentences: 'The present study aimed to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran.' and 'Participants were 568 men and 525 women from seven universities in Tehran, Iran.'
